findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "text" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: markdown_to_html · Private data: diff_text, markdown_to_html, html_to_text · Public sink: text_frequency, html_to_text · Destructive: text_extract, diff_text, html_to_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: markdown_to_html · Private data: diff_text, markdown_to_html, html_to_text · Public sink: text_frequency, html_to_text · Destructive: text_extract, diff_text, html_to_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
